title: Shah Rukh Khan's Knight Riders Win Maiden MLC Title in One-Run Thriller Over Washington Freedom
excerpt: Sunil Narine's devastating 3/13 spell and Shadley van Schalkwyk's three-wicket final over sealed Los Angeles Knight Riders' first Major League Cricket championship in a breathtaking finish.
body:
Key Takeaways
  • Los Angeles Knight Riders won the MLC 2026 final by one run against Washington Freedom.
  • Sunil Narine's 3/13 performance dismantled Freedom's top order early in the match.
  • Obus Pienaar scored 53 off 24 balls, nearly leading Freedom to victory.
  • Knight Riders now have 10 T20 titles, second only to Mumbai Indians' 13.
  • The win signifies a milestone for American cricket and the Knight Riders franchise.
  • Los Angeles Knight Riders defeated Washington Freedom by one run in the MLC 2026 final, defending a total of 164 in a nail-biting finish.
  • Sunil Narine took 3/13, dismissing the top three batters inside the powerplay to break the chase early.
  • Obus Pienaar's 53 off 24 balls nearly pulled off an improbable upset, but Shadley van Schalkwyk took three wickets in the final over to seal the title.
  • The Knight Riders franchise now holds 10 T20 trophies globally, second only to Mumbai Indians' 13 across all formats.

Narine Demolishes Top Order

Sunil Narine has made a career of rising to the biggest occasions, and the MLC 2026 final was no different. The veteran Caribbean spinner ripped through Washington Freedom's top order inside the powerplay, dismissing Mitchell Owen (9), Rachin Ravindra (7), and captain Steve Smith (8) to leave the defending champions reeling at 29 for 3.

Smith, who had scored a century in the Eliminator and a rapid 43 in the Challenger, was cleaned up around his stumps — a dismissal that effectively ended Freedom's hopes of controlling the chase. Narine finished with figures of 3/13 from his four overs, the kind of spell that separates champions from contenders.

> **"With 14 needed from six balls, the outcome hung on every delivery.

Pienaar's Blitz Falls One Run Short

Washington Freedom's middle order crumbled around the steady resistance of Andries Gous, who compiled 40 in an attempt to anchor the chase. But it was Obus Pienaar who transformed the final from a procession into a classic.

Walking in with Freedom needing 65 off the last six overs, Pienaar unleashed a devastating cameo of 53 off just 24 balls — five sixes and three fours — dragging the contest to the final over. With 14 needed from six balls, the outcome hung on every delivery.

"What started as a dream has become a reality today. Bringing cricket to Los Angeles is a landmark moment for all of us."

— Shah Rukh Khan, Co-owner, Knight Riders Group

Van Schalkwyk Nerves of Steel

Shadley van Schalkwyk, tasked with bowling the final over, delivered under immense pressure. The South African pacer dismissed three Freedom batters in the last six balls, denying them a win on the final delivery as LAKR clinched the title by the narrowest of margins — one run.

Jason Holder, the Knight Riders captain, was among the first to embrace his bowler as the team erupted in celebration. Holder had earlier contributed with the ball, picking up two crucial middle-order wickets including the key scalp of Nikhil Chaudhary, who had added 65 with Gous to briefly revive the chase.

LAKR's Batting Sets the Platform

Earlier, batting first, the Knight Riders got off to a brisk start through a 66-run opening partnership between Colin Munro (40) and Andre Fletcher (47). But Washington Freedom's bowlers fought back superbly in the middle overs — both Andre Russell and Narine fell for ducks, and the innings subsided to 164 all out in 19.4 overs. Matthew Tromp's 39 provided late impetus, but few would have predicted that 164 would prove enough.

Knight Riders' Global Empire Grows

The title marks a significant milestone for the Knight Riders Group, co-owned by Bollywood megastar Shah Rukh Khan, actress Juhi Chawla, and Jay Mehta. The franchise now holds 10 T20 trophies across its global portfolio — three IPL titles with Kolkata Knight Riders, five Caribbean Premier League titles with Trinbago Knight Riders, one Women's CPL title, and now one MLC crown.

Only the Mumbai Indians family, with 13 titles, has more T20 silverware globally.

For American cricket, the result caps a tournament that has steadily built credibility. The Knight Riders Cricket Ground in Pomona, inaugurated by Khan earlier this season, is designated to host cricket at the 2028 Los Angeles Olympics — making this title win more than just a trophy. It is a statement of intent.
